# AltorLab ADA Compliance

> AltorLab provides ADA and WCAG compliance scanning for D2C and e-commerce brands in the United States. In 2025, 8,667 ADA website lawsuits were filed in the US, with 77% targeting e-commerce sites. Shopify stores account for 32% of all ADA lawsuits.

## Compliance Scanning

- [Free ADA Scan](https://altorlab.app): Scan your store for accessibility violations
- [Shopify Compliance](https://altorlab.app/compliance/shopify.html): ADA guide for Shopify stores
- [WooCommerce Compliance](https://altorlab.app/compliance/woocommerce.html): ADA guide for WooCommerce
- [All Platforms](https://altorlab.app/compliance/): 8 platform guides

## WCAG 2.2 Reference

- [All WCAG Criteria](https://altorlab.app/wcag/): 78 success criteria explained for e-commerce
- [Contrast Minimum](https://altorlab.app/wcag/1-4-3-contrast-minimum.html): WCAG 1.4.3
- [Keyboard Access](https://altorlab.app/wcag/2-1-1-keyboard.html): WCAG 2.1.1

## Blog

- [ADA Lawsuits 2026](https://altorlab.app/blog/ada-lawsuits-2026.html): What D2C brands need to know
- [Shopify ADA Compliance](https://altorlab.app/blog/shopify-ada-compliance.html): Complete guide
- [accessiBe Alternative](https://altorlab.app/blog/accessibe-alternative.html): Why overlays aren't enough

## Key Statistics

- 8,667 ADA website lawsuits filed in US (2025)
- 77% target e-commerce sites
- 32% involve Shopify stores
- Fashion Nova settled for $5.15M (largest ADA web settlement)
- 98% of SMB websites are NOT ADA compliant
